# Exemptions for scripts/privacy-guard.mjs. The guard reads this file from the base (main's
# tip), so a pull request that adds an exemption gets it only after that pull request has
# merged. A waiting pull request gets it on its next run, with no merge of main.
# The guard flags a change to this file, its script or its workflow: read every line.
#
#   email <domain-or-address>     an address, or a domain and its subdomains
#   path <glob> <rule,rule | *>   the named rules are not applied to matching files
#   repo <name>                   a private repository whose name public files may use
#   product <Name>                a public product name that is also a private repository's name.
#                                 Only the bare word, spelled exactly so (case counts), and not
#                                 joined to a path, an underscore, a handle or a longer name. The
#                                 org-prefixed form, a near-miss spelling and a line that says
#                                 private are still flagged.
#   commit <sha>                  a commit (the full 40 hex) whose own diff and message are exempt.
#                                 A pushed commit cannot be rewritten, so this clears a false
#                                 positive in one that is not the tip. The net diff is still read.
#
# Rules: private-ip, session-id, tailnet-name, internal-host, private-repo, email,
# owner-quote, new-file. The reserved example domains need no line: they are built in.

# Public workflows and scripts here read the private ops repository by design, and its
# name is already in dozens of files. The pull request check's secret leaves it out; this
# line does the same for the local pre-push hook, which lists every private repository.
repo ops

# Public product names that share a private repository's name.
product MoonMan
product BinderCurve

# Test fixtures hold planted bad values on purpose. Only this directory, so a folder
# named fixtures somewhere else is not a way round the guard.
path test/fixtures/** *

# Commit b642bd3 (PR 241): its diff holds SSH-remote test fixtures for the public-push guard, no real address.
commit b642bd39924c04e50b4ef17894fe417045b16464
